summary: Completed comprehensive testing of the rebuilt ApplyForm (5-step wizard). Backend endpoints work correctly including the fixed parse_power_m function ('12,5M' → 12.5M). Frontend wizard flows perfectly on desktop and mobile with all validation, navigation, draft, and review features working as specified.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/applications/check-pseudo returns correct states (free/active/accepted/cooldown/invalid)
Backend: POST /api/applications creates application with valid payload and returns tracking code GP-1023-XXXX
Backend: Duplicate pseudo returns 409 with code 'duplicate_active'
Backend: Short message (<10 chars) returns 422 validation error
Backend: Power parsing '12,5M' correctly parsed as 12.5M (not 125M) - FIX VERIFIED
Backend: Admin stats and export endpoints work correctly
Frontend Desktop (1920x800): Complete happy path - all 5 steps work perfectly
Frontend Desktop: Step 1 - pseudo live check shows 'free' state, power quick chips work, power hint shows 'inRange'
Frontend Desktop: Step 2 - troops and activity selection required and working
Frontend Desktop: Step 3 - discord optional field works
Frontend Desktop: Step 4 - message validation (min 10 chars), counter updates correctly
Frontend Desktop: Step 5 - review panel shows 4 sections and 7 rows, oath validation works
Frontend Desktop: Success modal appears with correct pseudo, tracking code format GP-1023-XXXX, copy button changes to COPIÉ
Frontend Desktop: Modal next-steps and wait-time sections present
Frontend Desktop: goto-suivi button navigates to /suivi with tracking code visible
Frontend Desktop: Form resets to step 0 after success, localStorage draft cleared
Frontend Mobile (390x844): Complete happy path works, success modal scrollable and functional
Frontend Mobile: Modal close button (X) works, form resets correctly
Validation: Empty step 1 shows pseudo, power, and step-error-summary
Validation: Invalid power 'abc' shows 'unreadable' hint
Validation: Blocked pseudo 'TestAlpha' shows 'active' state with CTA button, prevents progression
Validation: Step 2 without selections shows troops and activity errors
Validation: Message < 10 chars shows error with counter showing remaining characters
Navigation: wizard-prev-btn goes back correctly
Navigation: Progress buttons (apply-step-0 to apply-step-4) allow jumping to reached steps
Navigation: review-edit-identity jumps to step 0
Navigation: review-edit-force jumps to step 1
Navigation: review-edit-signals jumps to step 2
Navigation: review-edit-letter jumps to step 3
Navigation: review-edit-btn jumps to step 3
Draft: Auto-saves to localStorage 'gp_apply_draft' after 400ms
Draft: draft-restored banner appears on page reload with values restored
Draft: draft-clear-btn clears form and removes from localStorage
Responsive: Tested 6 viewports (1920x800, 1366x768, 1024x768, 768x1024, 390x844, 375x667) - no horizontal scroll
Responsive: Touch targets adequate (>= 44px) on mobile
Responsive: Input font sizes adequate (>= 16px) on mobile to prevent zoom
Console: No React errors or warnings during full flow (only Lenis scroll library warnings and expected 401s)
notes: Language switching works (EN button in nav) but causes page reload - this is expected behavior
Console warnings about Lenis scroll library positioning are non-critical
401 errors in console are expected for unauthenticated role checks
All test applications cleaned up successfully
The form is production-ready with excellent UX on both desktop and mobile
